name: Thabo Cele
bio:
Thabo's culinary journey began in the vibrant kitchens of Durban, South Africa, where he honed his skills in traditional cuisine. His passion for motorsport ignited during a local rally event, sparking a desire to combine his culinary expertise with the high-octane world of racing. He started as a junior chef at a small racing team, quickly proving his ability to manage catering for large groups under immense pressure.

His approach to catering is meticulous, emphasizing fresh, locally sourced ingredients and catering to diverse dietary needs. He believes that a well-fed team is a focused team. Thabo's reputation for creating comforting, yet energizing meals, has earned him a loyal following within the paddock. What sets him apart is his ability to adapt to constantly changing schedules and locations, ensuring the Haas F1 Team is always fueled for success.

physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a warm smile and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served.
Has a habit of humming traditional Zulu songs while preparing food.
